$comment: SPEC 06 §3 — presets are data, not code, so they can be corrected without touching logic. No model names, prices or limits are stored here: models are always discovered with listModels or typed by the user. `capabilities` lists only what the endpoint genuinely offers.

presets.name: Groq
presets.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint with text and audio transcription.

presets.name: OpenRouter
presets.notes: Text only: this gateway does not offer the audio transcriptions endpoint.

presets.name: Anthropic
presets.notes: Text only. JSON is requested in the prompt and validated by the app.

presets.name: Ollama (this computer)
presets.notes: Free app that runs language models on your computer. Nothing leaves this machine.

presets.name: Ollama (another computer)
presets.notes: Replace the address with the other computer's IP. Transcript text will leave this machine.

presets.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)
presets.notes: Any service that speaks the OpenAI wire format. Enter its base URL.
